final: WITH country_averages AS (SELECT c.country, AVG(cs.wins) AS wins_average FROM constructorStandings AS cs JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY c.country), overall AS (SELECT AVG(wins_average) AS average_wins FROM country_averages), kept AS (SELECT ca.country, ca.wins_average, ca.wins_average - o.average_wins AS excess FROM country_averages AS ca CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE ca.wins_average > o.average_wins), latter AS (SELECT AVG(wins_average) AS average_wins FROM kept) SELECT AVG(k.wins_average), AVG(k.excess), AVG(k.wins_average - l.average_wins) FROM kept AS k CROSS JOIN latter AS l WHERE k.wins_average > l.average_wins
